component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.records.audit
component.documentation:
Access logging and the audit export, on the platform's audit.
The platform's audit already records what retention, holds and deletions do to a record, and every file its download service sends. The add-on adds a view of a record under retention or a legal hold, a disposition run's decisions on each of its records, a physical record's custody, and each audit export: its own events, which its writer below adds to the platform's audit once their transaction has committed, so that it needs no entry in the audit's own configuration.
A view is logged by the platform's JSON writer for a document, which this component replaces with a subclass that writes the same JSON and logs a view when the document is the answer itself, not an entry of a list.
An audit export, filed in the disposition runs folder, is written in the background once the filer's transaction has committed (README, "The audit export").
